correctness.rationale: By exhaustive enumeration directly from sixteen lexicographically sorted stable triples, the simplicial face sets have vectors (16,84,184,186,88,16) and (16,68,88,42,8) with N subset Ind. The standalone checker reconstructs the 16 dihedral automorphisms and verifies 14 listed representative free/coface pairs, disjoint full orbits of lengths 8 or 16, a unique current codimension-one coface per lower face, no N face removed, invariant remainder after each orbit, and exact final equality with N: 176 genuine elementary collapses. Group-equivariant orbitwise deformation follows from canonical simplicial straight-line collapses of disjoint free pairs. All 16 signed Lefschetz traces agree. The argument is a finite exhaustive certificate, not a sampled-computation-to-infinite leap.

value.rationale: This identifies a natural, previously undetermined *map* between two canonical constructions of the same vertex-critical four-chromatic Schrijver graph: independent families and common-neighborhood families. The explicit full-dihedral relative simplicial deformation retraction is stronger than two abstract sphere classifications or equal ranks, with a 14-orbit/176-pair structural certificate and equivariant homology identification. It is a motivated comparison raised by the adjacent Braun and Braun-Zeckner literatures, not an arbitrary deletion or table lookup; analogous equivalence fails for generic triangle-free graphs and there is no general SG(n,2) theorem. The orientation character is a corollary, not offered as the principal value.
